title: Identification of Elucamide as an Organic Compound which Affects Mechanical Properties of Poly (vinyl chloride)–Inorganic Filler Binary Composite System
abstract: Abstract                The mechanical properties (yield strength) were measured for poly (vinyl chloride)–inorganic compound binary composite systems. Among them, only the PVC-talc system did not show the decreasing yield strength with increasing talc content. Elucamide was isolated from talc and identified as an organic compound which can provide inhibitory action of such a decreasing yield strength.
